about: Claims about a real exam that an exam check has ruled false or unverified. tools/check_claims.mjs fails on any match in a course's lessons, explanations, review page or mock explanations. Add a rule every time an exam check fails a claim, so the same mistake can't ship twice. Fields: course (or *), pattern (JS regex, case insensitive), unless (optional regex; a match on the same sentence clears it), why, ruled (date and review file).

rules.why: Real Table Reading items include choices that are neither neighbors nor the swapped cell (2015 pamphlet Part B.2)
No official source bans calculators on the AFOQT; say scratch paper, practice without one
Real IC wrong pictures can miss on more than one reading (pamphlet sample X); that's only our practice-test build rule

rules.pattern: nobody scores|no score to protect|isn'?t scored at all
rules.why: The SDI is not graded but is used for job fit; say 'not graded'

rules.pattern: number right is the score|scores? (is|are) (just |the )?number right
rules.why: Pearson: scores don't refer to the raw number right; say 'built from the number right'
Official term is exception to policy; crew chiefs may say waiver loosely in dialogue

rules.pattern: \b(approved|endorsed|sanctioned) by (the )?(PMI|Project Management Institute|ISACA|HIMSS|INCOSE|LSAC|FAA|GitHub|Microsoft|Department of the Air Force|Air Force|AFPC|Pearson)\b
rules.why: Never claim approval or endorsement by an exam body

rules.pattern: answer (it )?(the way|as) the outline|(after|before|predates?) the outline[^.]{0,80}\b(answer|on the exam)\b|outline (is |was )?dated[^.]{0,120}\banswer\b|counts? toward required approvals, answer no|that'?s the exam answer
rules.why: An outline's publication date doesn't freeze the answer key; Microsoft says commonly used preview features may be tested. Teach current behavior with its surface, plan and policy conditions
rules.ruled: 2026-11-07 Codex audit (gh300 ch07 Two signatures, review.js)

rules.why: The ECO describes case questions placed anywhere, not a case study section that opens the exam
The real PMP exam scores 170 of 180; 10 are unscored pretest items. Our mock scores all 180, so never say that matches the real test
A detective control can compensate for a weak preventive control if it addresses the risk in time; adequacy depends on timeliness and residual risk
rules.ruled: 2026-11-07 Codex audit (cisa ch12 Kinds of controls)

rules.pattern: any network[^.]{0,100}\bTLS\b|without (TLS|it), anyone on the path
rules.why: Teach the requirement (protect data in transit with an appropriate protocol or architecture), not one protocol for every network

rules.pattern: believe (her|him|them|the witness) about[^.]{0,60}(you'?d better|you must|you have to) believe
rules.why: A witness's credibility can differ from one observation to the next; no categorical inference
rules.ruled: 2026-11-07 Codex audit (lsat ch04 Weight both ways)

rules.pattern: what does (this|the second) author do to the first
rules.why: Comparative passages often address a topic independently; don't teach that the second author always acts on the first
EMTALA (42 CFR 489.24(d)(4)): registration may ask about insurance if it doesn't delay the screening exam; what waits is seeking insurer authorization

rules.pattern: 500 or more[^.]{0,30}\bHHS too\b|(under|fewer than|less than|below) 500[^.]{0,40}\b(no|not|don'?t|doesn'?t|needn'?t|skip)\b[^.]{0,30}\bHHS\b|only (breaches (of|affecting) )?500 or more[^.]{0,40}\bHHS\b
rules.why: HIPAA breach notice (45 CFR 164.408): breaches under 500 still go to HHS, logged and reported within 60 days after the calendar year ends
